documents.title: Bambu PLA Basic Technical Data Sheet V3.0
Bambu PLA Basic Safety Data Sheet (SDS20250724A00)
Bambu PLA Basic 4 pack Hex Code
Filament guide: printer, nozzle, AMS and build plate compatibility

notes: The product has no colour option group (its options are Type "Filament with spool" and Size "1kg*4"); the four colours are bundle contents, so each hex entry is keyed by the colour name the hex table prints and carries the matching bundle line (bundle_item), with no option-value scope.

TDS values with no registry key (not stored): Spool Material "ABS (Temperature resistance 70 °C)"; Spool Size "Diameter: 200 mm; Height: 67 mm"; Printing and Storage Humidity "< 20% RH (Sealed with desiccant)"; Retraction Length 0.6 - 1.0 mm; Retraction Speed 20 - 40 mm/s; Max Overhang Angle 55°; Max Bridging Length 30 mm; Melt Index 23.2 ± 3.5 g/10 min (210 °C, 2.16 kg); Saturated Water Absorption Rate 0.43% (25 °C, 55% RH); Young's Modulus X-Y 2580 ± 220 MPa / Z 2060 ± 170 MPa; all Z-direction mechanical values; annealing advice (50 to 60 °C, 6 to 12 h).
The TDS Crystallization Temperature row reads "N/A" (no registry key either).

The registry has no *.printed / *.material key split: every mechanical.* value here is a printed-specimen result (TDS Specimen Test), stated in test_condition; the raw-material values are density, melting, glass transition, Vicat and HDT (Physical Properties).

Bed surface preparation "Glue" (TDS p.1) is not written as a product-wide "requires" relation: the wiki material table marks glue required only for the Engineering Plate with PLA, and the PLA Usage Guide says PLA Basic "can be printed directly after opening".

The deterministic page payload carries a "requires spool" relation from the FAQ sentence "The refill filament needs to be used with a spool."; this product's only Type value is "Filament with spool", so that refill guideline does not apply to it.

material.diameter_tolerance (± 0.03 mm) and the spool type come from the store page (feature bullet, Type option) and are left to the deterministic layer; neither is in the TDS, and neither is marked not published.

safety.certifications is not written and not marked not published: the store page links RoHS, POPs, CP65, TSCA, SVHC, PAHs and EN71-3 reports, which were not among the cached documents and were not read.
Basic Info prose in the TDS ("printing speeds up to 250-300 mm/s") and the store page prose ("up to 258mm/s*") prove no number; print_settings.print_speed uses the settings-table row only.
